retrieval_skill.name: incident_mechanism_recovery_search
retrieval_skill.description: Retrieve operational disruptions by separating the causal mechanism, the observable service constraint, the affected metric, the incident window, and the post-restoration pattern.
retrieval_skill.applicability: When forecasting a time series that may be altered by a documented outage, depletion, lockout, or other temporary operational regime.
retrieval_skill.query_strategy: Search for source-backed statements covering incident onset and end, physical or software constraints, the metric’s behavior during the disruption, restoration timing, and whether recovery is a one-time backlog release or a persistent regime shift. Then reconcile those facts with the series’ recurring cadence.
retrieval_skill.verification_rule: Accept a claim only when evidence explicitly identifies the affected system and metric, supports the full relevant temporal window, and distinguishes observed outcomes from inferred mechanisms. Preserve exact-quote and provenance requirements, reject unsupported extrapolation, and verify recovery-shape claims against both documented restoration behavior and the established pre-incident rhythm.
